subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should agents receive a new shared structured inbound attachment metadata field, and what fields plus visibility rules should Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins use?
rationale: This changes the shared channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary; code inspection shows a Slack-only fix would be easy but likely the wrong permanent API.

options.title: Design shared metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting likely migration and documentation churn when other channel plugins need the same shape.

options.title: Keep placeholders
options.body: Confirm placeholders plus download-file are the supported workflow and close the metadata request after that product decision.

recommendation.title: Design shared metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already in the issue discussion and have recent Slack plugin surface history, while shared-contract input can be pulled from the adjacent owners.
